rules.label: Hospital Discounted Care (sliding scale) for Colorado residents at or below 250% FPL who are uninsured or underinsured, emergency or medically necessary care
rules.quote: HDC is available for all Emergency and Medically Necessary care to all Qualified Patients with an annual family Income of up to 250% FPL guidelines (or less)

rules.label: limited help for inpatient care from 251% to 400% FPL
rules.quote: CHCO provides additional limited financial assistance for Inpatient Services only for individuals 251% to 400% FPG.

rules.label: some limited help for emergency care, any patient
rules.quote: CHCO does offer some limited financial assistance for Emergency medical services to all patients

rules.label: standard 35% self-pay discount when the patient doesn't have HDC
rules.quote: At the time of billing, if the patient does not have HDC, a standard 35% discount will be applied to all self-pay balances.

application.quote: The application must be completed within 365 days from the date of services or date of discharge.

eca_not_before.quote: CHCO will not initiate ECAs for at least 120 days from the date CHCO provides the first

payment_plan.quote: Monthly installments for hospital charges will not exceed 4% of their monthly household Income

notes: Hand-written reference model. Bills may go out from day 46: 'Billing Statements may be sent beginning 46 days after the date of service'.

HDC is limited to uninsured or underinsured patients: 'CICP and CHCO's HDC programs are not insurance coverage, but rather discounted care programs for patients who are Uninsured or Underinsured and have demonstrated financial need.' (Reference corrected 2026-10-28 after Nemotron 3 Ultra's model surfaced this clause and the 35% self-pay discount.)
